instruction: Review the access requests for employee E-221 using the available sources. Determine which permissions should be approved and which denied based on policy, and which requests should be excluded from this review. Return only a JSON object with these fields: approved_permissions, denied_permissions, excluded_requests. approved_permissions must be an array of short snake_case labels for approved resource+permission pairs. denied_permissions must be an array of short snake_case labels for denied resource+permission pairs. excluded_requests must be an array of short snake_case labels for requests excluded from this review. Do not include explanation outside the JSON.

evaluation_criteria.scoring_notes: R1 sales_reports read: analyst role allows read on sales_reports → approved. R2 customer_pii read: policy prohibits PII without DPO approval → denied. R3 financial_reports write: analysts may only have read on financial_reports, not write → denied. N1 is E-330 (different employee) → excluded.
